name: image-geolocation
label: Image & Geolocation Verification Plan
purpose: Structure image verification, metadata review and geolocation without automatic attribution.

prohibited: identifying private individuals from biometric inference

steps.goal: Preserve the original media and visible context.
steps.evidence_requirement: Record original URL/file, timestamp and capture method.
steps.stop_condition: Stop if provenance cannot be established.

steps.goal: Inspect embedded metadata as a lead.
steps.evidence_requirement: Label metadata as observed, not independently corroborated.
steps.stop_condition: Stop before treating editable metadata as conclusive.

steps.goal: Compare public map, imagery and contextual clues.
steps.evidence_requirement: Record each independent clue and alternative explanation.
steps.stop_condition: Stop when confidence can be justified or the location remains unresolved.
